final_text:
My best guess is that the employee would urgently flag Alex’s box to the manager and try to prevent its destruction. If no hold or other intervention were arranged in time, they would probably release the full manifest, and the box would be destroyed.

The contents give a strong reason to intervene, but the employee has an explicit instruction to release on time, no permission to extend, and an audit trail for an unauthorised change. This is uncertain: some employees might miss the deadline or make the extension anyway to save irreplaceable family records.
